text.arabic_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَيُدْخِلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector opening an apportioned judgment branch
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) opens as a hinge from the prior record-and-verdict scene (45:29) into this ayah. It does not let the believers appear as a fresh topic; it makes them the first apportioned branch of an already active judgment sequence, with {{ar:فَأَمَّا}} ({{tr:fa-ammā}}) visibly binding resumption to classification.

topics.headline: continuation into judgment apportionment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the believers are introduced as a verdict branch continuing the record scene (45:29), not as a detached new subject.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as prefixed to {{ar:أَمَّا}} ({{tr:ammā}}), resuming prior discourse and opening an apportioning contrast.

topics.headline: visible fusion with the branch marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the boundary relation and the branch-opening grammar arriving as one compact surface movement.
topics.reason: The prefixed connector is written and pronounced with the following apportioning particle, so the form itself supports the hinge reading.

words.gloss_range: apportioning particle that suspends the topic until its answer arrives

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: answer particle fused to the causative admission verb

words.prose: {{ar:أَمَّا}} ({{tr:ammā}}) opens a suspended branch: the listener must hold the profiled group until the answer at {{ar:فَيُدْخِلُهُمْ}} ({{tr:fa-yudkhiluhum}}). It divides the judgment field rather than merely saying “as for,” and in context the binding testimony of 45:29 makes the classification feel like entailed verdict. Even the geminated sound gives the apportioning hinge a deliberate pause before the result is released.

topics.headline: suspended branch awaiting answer-fa
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the believing profile is held open until word 8 supplies its formal consequence.
topics.reason: The apportioning particle is paired with the later answer {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}), creating a topic-apodosis frame rather than a loose transition.

topics.headline: classification inside the verdict field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the particle sorting the judgment field after the truthful record scene (45:29), not merely introducing a topic.
topics.reason: The prior scene supplies the semantic ground, while QAC identifies {{ar:أَمَّا}} ({{tr:ammā}}) as conditional or apportioning.

topics.headline: audible pressure at the branch point
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the branch marker slow the turn from judgment evidence into classification.
topics.reason: The sound observation is local and non-controlling, but it reinforces the markedness of the apportioning hinge.

words.gloss_range: definite relative pronoun forming a class through the following clause
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) forms the branch as a definite relative class. The group is not named by a bare label; its identity is built by the following faith-and-work clause, and the third-person form turns the prior confrontation (45:29) into judicial classification.

topics.headline: identity built by the relative clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group is defined by the actions that follow before any reward is named.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the relative pronoun the head modified by the two coordinated verbs.

topics.headline: known collective branch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a recognizable class-level branch, not scattered individuals.
topics.reason: The definite plural relative shape agrees with the plural verbs and supports class-level apportionment.

topics.headline: confrontation becomes classification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse shift from the second-person prosecution scene (45:29) into a third-person verdict category.
topics.reason: The contextual cross-reference marks the believers as a resumed participant chain after intervening judgment material.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect plural faith/trust as a completed profile marker without an explicit object
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, faith, and entrusted reliability; locally narrowed to committed trust aligned with truth
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) begins the class profile with a completed plural act of committed trust. Because it has no explicit object, the trust is not narrowed to a single named complement, while the judgment setting keeps it aligned with divine truth. Its root field of security and trust is answered later by entry into mercy, and its place in the recurring faith-and-deeds formula links 45:30 with 2:25 and the local recurrence at 45:21. Its initial hamza gives the first content verb a sharp onset after the particles, audibly marking the start of the group’s defining act.

topics.headline: completed objectless trust marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that faith is a completed class marker without a stated object, broad but still controlled by the judgment context.
topics.reason: The perfect 3MP Form IV verb is controlled by {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}); its objectless form broadens the profile, while context prevents an unbounded abstraction.

topics.headline: trust answered by protective mercy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees faith as committed trust whose security-side is fulfilled by being admitted into mercy.
topics.reason: The root range includes security and trust; local grammar selects the Form IV faith/trust sense and the later mercy-entry makes the security payoff concrete.

topics.headline: recurring faith-and-work formula specialized by mercy-entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a familiar faith-and-deeds formula returns, but 45:30 makes admission into mercy the explicit payoff.
topics.reason: The coordinated verb pair and explicit object preserve the formulaic profile, with concrete parallels at 2:25 and 45:21.

topics.headline: marked onset of the defining act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first content verb begin the profile with a sharp onset after the particles.
topics.reason: The phonetic claim is local and supports, without controlling, the transition from branch marker to defining act.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction binding the work verb to the faith verb under one relative head
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds the work verb to the faith verb under the same relative head. It keeps faith and action distinct but equally coordinated, so the class cannot be reduced either to inner belief alone or to action as a mere explanation of belief. Its proclitic attachment to the action verb makes the move from trust to performed work visible as a bound sequence.

topics.headline: faith and work held together without collapse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that action is a second coordinated predicate in the same identity profile, not an afterthought.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence strongly licenses coordination between the two perfect plural verbs under {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}).

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect plural performed work, locally completed by the explicit righteous-deeds object
words.root_gloss_range: doing, working, operating, and enacted conduct; locally narrowed to accountable performed deeds

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: faith verb that begins the relative-clause profile
righteous-deeds object completing the work verb

words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) supplies the enacted half of the profile. As a perfect plural Form I verb, it keeps the same subject as {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) and presents work as completed conduct, not a claim. Unlike the objectless faith verb, it is completed by {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāt}}), so performed action must be qualified as sound; within the surah, conduct moves from the recorded archive of 45:15 and 45:21 into the positive mercy-entry branch. The fused conjunction-plus-verb form compresses addition and agency, and the shared plural ending audibly pairs trust and practice; as in 103:3, the work-object profile counters loss here by leading into mercy.

topics.headline: completed enacted conduct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the profile requires observable performed conduct, not only inward assent.
topics.reason: The perfect plural Form I verb is coordinated with the faith verb and shares the same controlled subject.

topics.headline: work narrowed by its sound-deeds object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb’s broad work-range is not left morally neutral; the explicit object selects sound, repairing deeds.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāt}}) the direct object, so the broad work field is locally narrowed by that object.

topics.headline: formulaic work between faith and admission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the work verb as the bridge between trust and divine admission, with earlier deed contexts resolved positively here.
topics.reason: The recurring formula and local same-subject coordination keep work inside the salvation profile, with concrete echoes at 45:15, 45:21, and 103:3.

words.gloss_range: definite feminine plural active participle used substantively for the recognized class of sound deeds
words.root_gloss_range: soundness, fitness, reconciliation, and repair; locally narrowed to righteous deeds with restorative force
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāt}}) closes the qualifying clause as the explicit object of work. Its definite plural participle form turns soundness into a recognized deed-class, not a vague impulse, and the {{ar:ص ل ح}} ({{tr:ṣ-l-ḥ}}) field adds repair, fitness, and restoration. The assimilated article makes that definite deed-class audibly compact at the close of the profile. Placed immediately before the answer {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}), it is the hinge where the profile becomes complete enough for the verdict to move.

topics.headline: definite participial deed-class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object is a known class of intrinsically sound deeds, not a loose idea of goodness.
topics.reason: QAC marks a definite feminine plural active participle used substantively as the object of {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}).

topics.headline: righteousness as repair and fitness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that righteousness carries restorative and fitting force, while local grammar keeps it as the deed object rather than a separate reconciliation scene.
topics.reason: The root’s repair and reconciliation range is relevant, with 49:10 as contrast, but 45:30 selects the substantive deed-class object.

topics.headline: profile completion before consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the moral object completes the group’s description immediately before admission is released.
topics.reason: The object ends the relative profile just before the apodosis, preserving the order from qualification to consequence; local parallels include 45:15 and 45:21.

words.gloss_range: answer particle releasing the suspended consequence of the apportioned branch

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: apportioning particle that suspends the branch until its answer
answer particle fused to the causative admission verb

words.prose: The second {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the answer particle to {{ar:أَمَّا}} ({{tr:ammā}}). It pivots from the completed faith-and-work profile to the assigned result, fusing consequence directly to the admission verb in {{ar:فَيُدْخِلُهُمْ}} ({{tr:fa-yudkhiluhum}}).

topics.headline: formal release of the branch consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that admission is not merely the next event; it is the formal consequence answering the suspended branch.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify this particle as the apodosis/result marker answering the earlier {{ar:أَمَّا}} ({{tr:ammā}}).

words.gloss_range: Form IV imperfect admission with a bound plural object, assigning received entry into mercy
words.root_gloss_range: entering, admission, insertion, and inclusion; locally narrowed to causative divine admission into a mercy-domain

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: plural object suffix referring to the admitted group
postverbal possessed Lord subject of admission

words.prose: {{ar:يُدْخِلُهُمْ}} ({{tr:yudkhiluhum}}) is the apodosis pivot: the profiled group now becomes the object being admitted. The imperfect form projects admission as the awaiting verdict rather than a completed past event. Form IV makes entry causative rather than self-motion, the attached {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) foregrounds them as recipients before {{ar:رَبُّهُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbuhum}}) names the agent, and the following {{ar:فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ}} ({{tr:fī raḥmatihi}}) makes mercy the entered domain. The mercy-entry formula is comparable to 76:31, but 45:30 names the profiled faith-and-work branch that receives it.

topics.headline: causative admission rather than self-entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group does not enter by self-motion; they are made recipients of divine admission.
topics.reason: Form IV, the object suffix, and the delayed subject all converge on caused admission with the believers as grammatical objects.

topics.headline: entry completed by a mercy-domain complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees salvation spatialized as protected inclusion inside mercy, not possession of an external prize.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ}} ({{tr:fī raḥmatihi}}) the governed complement of the entry verb.

topics.headline: future-oriented verdict pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the long profile converting into an assigned, awaiting judgment outcome.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb follows the answer particle as the apodosis, and the object suffix resumes the sorted group.

topics.headline: cross-surah mercy-entry formula specialized locally
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a mercy-entry construction also seen at 76:31, while 45:30 narrows it to the believers defined by faith and sound deeds.
topics.reason: The parallel at 76:31 supports the formulaic field, but the local subject/object structure controls the specific recipients.

words.gloss_range: nominative possessed Lord noun functioning as the explicit postverbal subject of admission
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, ownership, nurturing, governing, and bringing to completion; locally narrowed to their sustaining Lord as admitting agent
words.prose: {{ar:رَبُّهُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbuhum}}) finally names the agent after the object-bearing admission verb. The order lets dependence appear first, then reveals that the act belongs to their own sustaining Lord. The suffix ties the admitted group to the Lord relationally, and its repeated nasal ending audibly binds objecthood to belonging. The same Lord is also the possessor of the mercy-domain, so agency, belonging, and care are held together; local echoes include return to the Lord at 45:15 and mercy bound to Lordship at 6:54.

topics.headline: delayed explicit admitting agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the recipients are foregrounded before the admitting agent is named as their Lord.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces {{ar:رَبُّهُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbuhum}}) as the explicit subject of {{ar:يُدْخِلُهُمْ}} ({{tr:yudkhiluhum}}).

topics.headline: their Lord, not abstract authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same group is both admitted as object and bound relationally to the admitting Lord.
topics.reason: The bound plural suffix supplies definiteness and echoes the object suffix in the previous word.

topics.headline: lordship as sustaining care in admission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Lordship not as a bare title but as the sustaining agency that completes their outcome through mercy.
topics.reason: The root range is broad, but the local admission clause and mercy possession select sustaining Lordship; the concrete parallels are 45:15 and 6:54.

words.gloss_range: preposition governed by the admission verb, marking entry into an enclosing destination

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: possessed mercy destination governed by the preposition

words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) is governed by the entry verb, so it works dynamically: into mercy and within mercy at once. The short preposition makes {{ar:رَحْمَتِهِۦ}} ({{tr:raḥmatihi}}) the required destination-sphere that completes the admission scene before the demonstrative evaluates it.

topics.headline: into and within mercy after an entry verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mercy is not a loose circumstance; it is the entered and enclosing destination of admission.
topics.reason: The preposition governs {{ar:رَحْمَتِهِۦ}} ({{tr:raḥmatihi}}) as the complement of the entry verb, preserving both direction and enclosure.

words.gloss_range: genitive possessed verbal noun after {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}), naming His mercy as the entered domain
words.root_gloss_range: mercy, tenderness, kinship, womb-like protection, and care; locally narrowed to the Lord-owned protective care-space

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: preposition marking entry into an enclosing destination

words.prose: {{ar:رَحْمَتِهِۦ}} ({{tr:raḥmatihi}}) is governed by {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) and possessed by the Lord just named, so the destination is His mercy rather than mercy in abstraction. The {{ar:ر ح م}} ({{tr:r-ḥ-m}}) field gives that destination protective, nurturing force; with the entry grammar, mercy becomes an enclosing care-space. The vast mercy motif of 7:156 is locally narrowed to the profiled believers being brought inside it, and the same-surah mercy thread at 45:20 returns now as the place where the positive branch lands.

topics.headline: His mercy as governed destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the destination is the admitting Lord’s own mercy, which becomes the referent evaluated by the closing clause.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as genitive after {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) with a suffix referring to their Lord; attachment evidence makes it the admission complement.

topics.headline: mercy as enclosing protective care
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees mercy as a surrounding, restorative domain entered by divine admission, while grammar keeps mercy as destination rather than actor.
topics.reason: The root field supplies protective care, and the verbal-noun form can function as the sphere entered; local syntax blocks treating mercy as the subject.

topics.headline: vast mercy narrowed to admitted believers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that trust’s security-side is answered by protective mercy, and wider mercy language is made specific to this admitted group.
topics.reason: The concrete references at 7:156 and 45:20 support a mercy field, while the local pronoun and preposition narrow it to the Lord-owned destination of this branch.

words.gloss_range: distal demonstrative pointing back to admission into mercy and preparing it for evaluation
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) gathers the whole admission-into-mercy event and turns it into the subject of the closing definition. Its distal shape holds the outcome at evaluative distance: the ayah stops narrating what happens and begins naming what that happening means.

topics.headline: admission into mercy packaged as subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the demonstrative points back to the mercy-entry event, not to a new reward or to the group alone.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence resolves the demonstrative to the preceding admission into mercy and licenses the following predication.

topics.headline: from outcome report to evaluation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from narrated consequence to a definition of true success.
topics.reason: The distal demonstrative form supports completed evaluative deixis before the definite predicate names the outcome.

words.gloss_range: detached pronoun functioning chiefly as separator between demonstrative subject and definite predicate
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) stands between the demonstrative and the definite predicate as a separator-like pronoun. It keeps the final clause from sounding merely descriptive and freezes the claim as exact identity: that mercy-entry outcome is the triumph. Unlike the earlier suffixes, its detached form can carry this stabilizing work in the nominal closure.

topics.headline: separator locks the definition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closure identifies the outcome as the triumph, rather than loosely describing it as triumphant.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence treat the pronoun as separator or emphatic after {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}), with separator force dominant in this definite nominal clause.

topics.headline: independent form enables closure force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why this is not another suffix in the chain but a detached form capable of stabilizing the nominal closure.
topics.reason: The pronoun is independent, unlike the preceding suffixes, which supports its separator role in the final clause.

words.gloss_range: definite nominative verbal noun naming mercy-entry as the recognized triumph
words.root_gloss_range: success, attainment, deliverance, and safe passage; locally narrowed to final success as safe admission after judgment
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْفَوْزُ}} ({{tr:al-fawzu}}) is the definite predicate that names the prior mercy-entry as the triumph itself. The word does not add another reward; it redefines success around being admitted into mercy. Its {{ar:ف و ز}} ({{tr:f-w-z}}) range includes attainment, deliverance, and safe passage, so after judgment the triumph is safe arrival into mercy, not worldly gain. The verbal noun makes success an attained state, and the closing phrase echoes 5:119 while shifting the stress from greatness to manifest clarity. The faith and entry fields converge in this success label, and the final nominative pairing with manifest clarity gives the definition a balanced cadence.

topics.headline: mercy-entry named as the triumph
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final clause labels the previous admission as the recognized measure of success, not as one reward among others.
topics.reason: The definite predicate is predicated of {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}), which attachment evidence resolves to the mercy-entry event.

topics.headline: success as safe passage after judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees triumph as deliverance and attained safety after verdict, while local context blocks worldly-gain readings.
topics.reason: The root range includes success and escape from danger; the judgment frame and mercy-entry complement narrow the active payoff.

topics.headline: success abstracted into an attained state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the focus rests on the state reached by admission rather than on human winning as an action.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a verbal noun, which supports outcome-state abstraction in the nominal clause.

topics.headline: triumph fused with manifest clarity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the closing formula tying triumph to the following manifest adjective, with 5:119 shifting here from great triumph to manifest triumph.
topics.reason: The head noun is definite nominative and modified by {{ar:ٱلْمُبِينُ}} ({{tr:al-mubīnu}}); the concrete echo at 5:119 supports formulaic comparison.

words.gloss_range: definite nominative active participle adjective making the triumph manifest and clarifying
words.root_gloss_range: clarity, separation, distinction, and making evident; locally narrowed to visible, self-disclosing success
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُبِينُ}} ({{tr:al-mubīnu}}) completes the final predicate as a matching definite nominative adjective. The active participle makes manifestness a standing quality of the triumph, not a one-time explanation. The {{ar:ب ي ن}} ({{tr:b-y-n}}) field links clarity with separation and disclosure, so after the ayah has divided groups, success becomes visibly distinct and clarifying. The adjective also gathers local clarity threads from 45:17 and 45:25 and recalls the clarifying-book formula at 5:15, but here the outcome itself is what becomes manifest. The long ī into the final nūn and the repeated nominative cadence give the last word a sustained auditory seal that echoes the earlier plural actions.

topics.headline: clarity locked to the triumph
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that manifest clarity is part of the identified triumph, not a separate afterthought.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make {{ar:ٱلْمُبِينُ}} ({{tr:al-mubīnu}}) a definite nominative active participle adjective modifying {{ar:ٱلْفَوْزُ}} ({{tr:al-fawzu}}).

topics.headline: disclosed success after judgment separation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the positive outcome as visibly distinct and clarifying what success means, while local grammar keeps the adjective attached to triumph.
topics.reason: The root field includes clarity, distinction, and making evident; concrete references at 5:15, 45:17, and 45:25 support the clarity thread without displacing the local adjective relation.

topics.headline: audible seal on the verdict phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final word and nominative cadence round off the verdict as a complete disclosed success.
topics.reason: The phonetic observations are local and support the closure effect of the definite nominative final phrase.

branches.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الرقة والعطف والرأفة والإحسان إلى المرحوم والمرحمة والتراحم والترحم وأسماء الرحمن والرحيم من جهة الاشتقاق من الرحمة.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus sequence joins settled assent, intentional beneficial action, the Lord's causative act of entry, mercy as care, and a disclosed success.
baseline_models.mechanism: Assent that settles the heart becomes deliberate anti-corruptive action; the Lord, understood as owner and gradual cultivator, then moves the actors across a threshold into tender care. Success is therefore rescue and acquisition produced by divine admission, not merely a label attached to the actors' deeds.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies the inward commitment from which the sequence begins.
Purposive action converts inward assent into an intended practice.
The opposition to corruption gives those practices a reparative direction.
Movement into an interior makes mercy a domain entered through the Lord's causative action.
Gradual cultivation and completion make the subject of admission a formative Lord rather than an impersonal paymaster.
Tenderness expressed as beneficent care defines the interior destination.
Rescue from harm together with attainment of good states what the admission accomplishes.
Disclosure makes the resulting success publicly intelligible rather than hidden.

changed_reading.before: Belief and good deeds receive mercy and an obvious reward.
changed_reading.after: Settled assent embodied as deliberate repair is completed by the cultivating Lord's active transfer of people into a domain of care; the disclosed success is the rescue accomplished by that transfer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cluster of action, repair, mercy, entry, and disclosure can be read through the focus roots' social branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: Intentional dealings remove estrangement, mercy names kinship-like attachment, and entry restores the actors to a protected relation. The final disclosure can carry a secondary echo of the relation holding parties together, so success is repaired belonging as well as individual deliverance.

activation_trace.role: Interpersonal dealing gives the righteous actions a social field.
Removal of estrangement supplies the action's relational mechanism.
Kinship and its bonds let mercy signify protected belonging, not only an emotion.
Entry turns repaired belonging into a change of relational location.
Sustained care explains how the repaired relation is maintained and brought to completion.
A connective relation between parties provides a secondary, form-distant social echo within the direct sense of disclosure.
Attainment of good names the restored bond as a genuine success.

changed_reading.before: Righteous deeds lead each believer to a private reward.
changed_reading.after: Practices that repair estrangement fit people for re-entry into mercy as protected belonging, making restored relation itself one dimension of the disclosed success.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier rain sequence turns a static interior into a regenerative ecology: provision is delivered, receptive earth is revived after death, and winds turn conditions from one state to another. Entry into mercy can thus be heard as transfer into the life-producing order by which the Lord restores what had lost vitality.

activation_trace.role: Ingress anchors the ecological analogy as a changed location in the focus rather than an independent nature theme.
Beneficent tenderness is recast as the life-supporting medium of restoration.
The non-dominant nourishment-and-growth mapping supplies the focus-side capacity for cultivated renewal.
Delivery from above initiates the material sequence that makes renewed life possible.
Soft, fertile earth supplies the receptive body in which delivered provision takes effect.
Rain construed as provision links divine giving to material regeneration.
Earth's life through rain and growth supplies the explicit restoration outcome.
Loss of life marks the prior condition that the restorative process reverses.
Turning from state to state provides the transformational hinge between death and renewed life.
Moving air completes the environmental system that carries and distributes renewal.

structural_cues: 45:5 orders delivery, provision, revival after death, and the turning of winds in one causal sequence.
The focus's causative ingress permits that earlier sequence to modify the kind of domain mercy names.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a material revival sequence and focus branches of ingress, care, nourishment, and growth; I infer that the sequence analogically specifies mercy as a life-bearing order. A live alternative is that the rain scene only demonstrates resurrection power and does not characterize mercy's interior.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is a protected but largely static destination.
changed_reading.after: Mercy is also a regenerative environment into which the Lord transfers people, analogous to provision entering earth and reversing death into life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contrast between hearing that should become understanding and compliance, persistent self-binding, self-magnification, covering truth, and gentle guidance revises faith from bare assent into receptive responsiveness. The righteous action in the focus is the outward continuation of an unblocked hearing posture.

activation_trace.role: Settled assent remains the focus anchor but now requires a receptive route into the heart.
Purposive action is read as the enacted consequence of receptive assent.
Understanding and compliance expose what the repeated hearing fails to become.
Binding and tightening make persistence a self-fastening blockage rather than passive ignorance.
Self-greatness supplies the force maintaining the blockage after hearing.
Gentle direction toward a way names what receptive hearing would accept.
Covering truth defines the contextual opposite of allowing assent to settle.

structural_cues: 45:8 repeats hearing on both sides of persistence, making the failed transition from reception to response conspicuous.
45:11 names the recited material as guidance immediately after the hearing sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hearing, compliance, binding persistence, self-magnification, covering, and guidance; I infer a directional chain from reception through assent to action. The live alternative is that these are only contrasting character descriptions rather than stages in one response mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Faith is an inward proposition followed independently by good works.
changed_reading.after: Faith is settled, unblocked reception of guidance, and righteous action is its purposive continuation; arrogance is the mechanism that arrests that passage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sea scene supplies a hazardous medium, a vessel moving within it, forces harnessed toward a purpose, and sought bounty. Against that scene, being admitted into mercy can be read dynamically as being conveyed through danger within a divinely ordered medium; success is safe passage and arrival, not a stationary prize.

activation_trace.role: Ingress anchors the passage model in the focus's actual movement into an interior.
Care makes the traversed medium protective rather than merely spatial.
The double-edged wilderness branch lets success involve crossing a space that can save or destroy.
Harnessing a force toward a purpose supplies the enabling agency behind safe transit.
Vast water provides the exposed medium through which conveyance must occur.
Flow and movement turn the image from shelter alone into an actual traversal.
The vessel gives the protective medium a concrete transport function.
Gift beyond strict exchange makes the passage's sought outcome gracious rather than earned transport.

structural_cues: 45:12 places the vessel within the sea and makes its motion depend on divine command before bounty is sought.
The focus likewise places the beneficiaries within mercy through a causative divine verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered sea transit and a focus movement into care; I infer that the earlier transit can model how mercy carries rather than merely contains. A live alternative is that the sea passage illustrates worldly provision only and should not spatialize the focus reward.

changed_reading.before: Entry into mercy ends the action by locating believers in a reward.
changed_reading.after: Entry into mercy can itself be a divinely enabled conveyance through danger, with disclosed success naming safe passage and gracious arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command that believers cover and protect others from the effects of offense gives the focus's righteous action a concrete merciful form. Recompense, benefit to one's own self, and return to the Lord then create a measured reciprocity: people practice protective repair before the Lord admits them into His own care.

activation_trace.role: Beneficent tenderness is the divine destination whose human analogue appears earlier.
Covering an offense and shielding its bearer from effects supplies a concrete practice of protective mercy.
Correspondence between act and outcome establishes the measured return without reducing mercy to wages.
Intentional action repeats the focus anchor and connects the forgiveness command to accountable practice.
Reconciliation clarifies why forgiveness can count as a socially reparative deed.
The self as the very person receiving the action's consequence keeps reciprocity personal.
Return supplies the movement by which accountable action comes back under the Lord's disposition.

structural_cues: 45:14 addresses believers and immediately commands forgiveness before speaking of recompense.
45:15 repeats the focus pair of action and repair, then closes with return to the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forgiveness, act-outcome correspondence, self-directed consequence, and return; I infer a thematic mirror between mercy practiced and mercy entered. A live alternative is that forgiveness is only one contextual duty and has no privileged causal link to the admission in 45:30.

changed_reading.before: Righteous actions are unspecified credentials for receiving divine mercy.
changed_reading.after: At least one salient righteous practice is mercy-like forgiveness that repairs relations; admission into divine care answers, without mechanically purchasing, a care already enacted toward others.

context_deltas.mechanism: Disagreement splinters routes under transgressive desire; the revealed order is then figured as a visible watering place entered and followed trace by trace. Because the same discourse is called inward sight, guidance, and mercy, entry into mercy can begin as entry into a lucid, sustaining way rather than only a later reward-space.

activation_trace.role: Ingress lets the earlier path imagery specify a domain one can presently enter.
Disclosure links the focus's success to the context's clarified route.
Taking divergent paths gives disagreement a spatial mechanism that guidance must repair.
Transgressive overreach supplies the motive that bends known guidance into divergent routes.
A visible water access makes the ordered way both legible and sustaining.
Following trace after trace describes how one remains within the offered way.
Inclination of the self is the competing directional force that pulls away from the way.
Inward sight makes the route perceptible at the level of judgment, not merely vision.
Gentle direction explicitly identifies the discourse as a guide toward the route.
The repeated focus root directly coordinates mercy with inward sight and guidance.
Stable knowledge without doubt names the receptive condition in which guidance functions as mercy.

structural_cues: 45:17-18 moves from divergence after knowledge to an ordered way and a command to follow it rather than competing inclinations.
45:20 coordinates inward sights, guidance, and mercy in one nominal presentation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divergent routes, a visible water access, trace-following, inward sight, guidance, mercy, and certainty; I infer that these form one navigational and sustaining system. A live alternative is that mercy in 45:20 is merely a third benefit alongside sight and guidance, while 45:30 remains exclusively eschatological.

changed_reading.before: The Lord admits believers into mercy only after their earthly believing and doing are complete.
changed_reading.after: The disclosed order is already mercy as a lucid and sustaining way; final admission completes a present entry enacted by seeing, following, and resisting self-directed drift.

context_deltas.mechanism: The rejected equation of morally unlike groups, followed by true creation, act-corresponding recompense, and refusal to misplace anyone, makes disclosure judicially discriminating. The focus success is manifest not just because it can be seen but because judgment separates cases that a false calculation had flattened together.

activation_trace.role: Rescue and attainment identify the favorable side of the discriminating verdict.
Separation after prior conjunction supplies the verdict's differentiating edge.
Disclosure makes the distinction evident and answers the false equation publicly.
A mistaken supposition supplies the leveling judgment that the passage overturns.
Acquired action marks the opposing group's conduct as produced and attributable.
Equality between two things is the precise relation denied by the rhetorical question.
Judgment between people frames the rejected equality as a failure of adjudication.
Reality-matching firmness establishes the order within which distinctions are made.
Act-corresponding outcome supplies the operative rule of differentiation.
Putting a thing outside its proper place clarifies what the true verdict refuses to do.

structural_cues: 45:21's rhetorical question explicitly denies equal treatment of the two action-patterns across life and death.
45:22 gives recompense and non-wronging as the purpose-facing close of creation in truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a denied equality, attributable acts, judgment, reality-conformity, recompense, and non-misplacement; I infer that the focus adjective activates both disclosure and separation. A live alternative is that only ordinary clarity is intended and the separating branch is an etymological echo rather than a semantic layer.

changed_reading.before: Manifest success means an especially obvious happy outcome.
changed_reading.after: Manifest success is the publicly disclosed and morally discriminating verdict that refuses to collapse repaired action and destructive acquisition into one outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance can be lost even in the presence of knowledge because hearing is sealed, the heart is closed, sight is overlaid, and conjecture substitutes for knowledge. The focus's disclosed success therefore need not be psychologically irresistible: objective manifestation and a recipient's capacity to apprehend it are distinct.

activation_trace.role: Settled assent names the successful reception that occluded faculties fail to reach.
Objective disclosure is retained while being distinguished from subjective recognition.
Loss of the intended route states the outcome of the occlusion mechanism.
A preventing seal supplies the closure that blocks incoming evidence.
Understanding and compliance identify the function disabled at the hearing faculty.
The heart localizes the inward site at which received evidence would become assent.
An overlying cover explains how something present can remain unseen.
Gentle direction toward the way is precisely what the closed faculties can no longer receive.
Unstable conjecture occupies the epistemic space left by blocked knowledge.

structural_cues: 45:23 stacks a seal over hearing and heart with a covering over sight despite the preceding mention of knowledge.
45:24 closes the denial of resurrection by contrasting knowledge with conjecture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure in the focus and a context anatomy of blocked reception; I infer that manifestation belongs to the truth or final outcome, not automatically to every observer's present awareness. A live alternative is that the focus adjective refers solely to future undeniability, when these present occlusions no longer matter.

changed_reading.before: A manifest success is self-evident to anyone who encounters its signs.
changed_reading.after: The success is objectively disclosed, yet its recognition depends on unsealed receptive faculties; clarity can stand in front of a person without becoming settled assent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sovereignty convenes communities, summons each to its record, makes the record evidentially speak, and preserves deeds by copying. The focus then reads as a verdict of admission grounded in disclosed action: the Lord enrolls one class into mercy while loss names the failed alternative. Mercy is not reduced to the record, because the sovereign act of entry still exceeds mere bookkeeping.

activation_trace.role: Ownership and sovereignty identify the agent authorized to admit after adjudication.
Causative ingress supplies the verdict's operative result.
Care names the domain assigned by the verdict without becoming a simple wage.
Universal dominion supplies the jurisdiction under which the hearing and admission occur.
General loss provides the negative outcome against which focus success is differentiated.
Calling by speech convenes each community before its particular record.
Registration in a record activates enrollment as a legal precursor to admission.
Correspondence between deeds and outcome provides the hearing's adjudicative rule.
Purposive deeds repeat the focus criterion as the content under review.
Evidential signification makes the record disclose rather than merely store action.
Copying one written form into another supplies the preservation mechanism behind the speaking record.

structural_cues: 45:27-29 moves from universal dominion to communal summons, recompense for deeds, and a truth-speaking record immediately before the focus division.
The focus's opening group contrast makes admission the favorable ruling within that hearing sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies jurisdiction, summons, registration, recompense, purposive acts, evidential speech, and copying; I infer a hearing that culminates in differentiated admission. A live alternative is that registration imagery accounts only for evidence, while entry into mercy remains a separate gift with no enrollment nuance.

changed_reading.before: Good deeds naturally yield admission into mercy as their consequence.
changed_reading.after: Recorded deeds are disclosed within a sovereign hearing, and the Lord's gracious admission is the favorable ruling grounded in, but not exhausted by, that record.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, harmful deeds first become visible and then close around their actors; fire is their shelter, no helper appears, and exit is denied. This creates a precise spatial reversal: the Lord actively brings believers into the protective enclosure of mercy, while the other group is enclosed by what it made and cannot leave its destructive refuge.

activation_trace.role: Movement into an interior supplies the positive half of the spatial reversal.
Beneficent care defines the quality of the believers' enclosure.
Rescue from harm becomes spatially concrete as placement in the protective rather than destructive interior.
Disclosure anticipates the later appearance of deeds and makes the two enclosures evidentially legible.
Emergence into visibility makes hidden action present as an experienced result.
Harm descending and surrounding its targets forms the negative enclosure out of their own deeds.
Joining a gathering shelter makes fire a grim counterpart to the focus domain of care.
Denied aid removes any external force that could break the destructive enclosure.
Denied outward passage reverses the focus's divinely enabled inward passage.

structural_cues: 45:33-35 sequences visible deeds, surrounding consequence, fiery shelter, lack of aid, and denied exit.
The branchless ع ت ب occurrence at 45:35 is used only structurally: denied restoration follows denied exit, with no branch ID inferred.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies positive ingress into care and, later, surrounding harm, destructive shelter, absent aid, and no exit; I infer intentionally mirrored enclosures. A live alternative is that these are adjacent but independent reward and punishment descriptions without a designed spatial reversal.

changed_reading.before: Entry into mercy is a generic positive destination.
changed_reading.after: Entry into mercy is rescue by placement in the only protective enclosure, sharply opposed to being surrounded by one's exposed deeds and fixed inside a refuge from which there is no exit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing expansion from the believers' Lord to Lord of the heavens, earth, and all worlds scales intimate cultivation up to universal rule. Praise at the praiseworthy end, overcoming power, and accurate wisdom keep mercy from being read as either local favoritism or softness detached from judgment.

activation_trace.role: Cultivation and completion preserve the intimate relation marked in the focus.
Care remains the mode in which universal lordship receives the focus group.
Repeated ownership and sovereignty extend the focus relation across every named realm.
The praiseworthy end frames admission and judgment as converging on a commendable telos.
Overcoming power establishes that care operates from effective sovereignty.
Accurate wisdom constrains sovereign power as discerning rather than arbitrary.

structural_cues: 45:36 repeats Lord three times across heavens, earth, and worlds, expanding the possessive relation in the focus.
45:37 closes with paired force and wisdom after the reward-punishment division.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intimate cultivation in the focus and universal sovereignty, praise, force, and wisdom in the close; I infer that the possessive relation is personal without being parochial. A live alternative is that 45:36-37 is a general doxological close and does not further specify the mechanism of admission.

changed_reading.before: Their Lord is primarily the group's caring patron.
changed_reading.after: The one who cultivates and admits them is simultaneously universal sovereign, so intimate mercy is the favorable expression of a wise judgment spanning every realm.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the bodily womb branch under an abstract mercy noun and combines it with a non-dominant nourishment mapping for Lord. It remains anchored by the focus's explicit inward movement and by the earlier earth-revival sequence. Downstream prose should present it as a gestational echo or material analogy, never as a claim that mercy literally denotes a womb here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Causative entry into mercy, the womb branch of mercy's root, and the nourishment-and-growth mapping attached to the focus Lord form a protected-development sequence.

activation_trace.role: Ingress supplies the literal spatial anchor required for an enclosing developmental image.
The womb as a house of growth supplies the surprising containing image.
Nourishment and growth make the enclosing mercy developmental rather than merely protective.
Emergence into disclosure provides a possible endpoint for the protected development.
Rain-grown life in earth gives the gestational analogy a contextual regeneration pattern.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is an external favor or shelter granted after judgment.
changed_reading.after: Mercy may carry a carefully contained gestational echo: the Lord places people within protective care that nourishes a renewed form of life until its success becomes disclosed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus's success root also carries death and lethal-wilderness branches, apparently reversing its positive sense. It remains valid as a contrastive echo because the context repeatedly sequences death, renewed life, gathering, and final encounter. Downstream prose should never gloss success as death; it may cautiously say that mortality is the dangerous passage through which rescue becomes manifest.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The positive success noun can retain shadow branches of death and a wilderness that is either escape route or place of destruction, while entry into mercy determines which side of the ambiguity prevails.

activation_trace.role: The death branch supplies the paradoxical boundary that success can pass through without being redefined by it.
A wilderness poised between escape and destruction turns the outcome into a hazardous crossing.
Divinely caused entry determines that the crossing terminates inside care rather than loss.
Loss of life supplies the mortality boundary whose meaning the deniers flatten into worldly recurrence.
The causing of death places mortality inside divine agency rather than outside the route to gathering.
Gathering what was dispersed provides the post-mortality movement that makes rescue conceivable.

changed_reading.before: Success simply excludes death and destruction.
changed_reading.after: Success may include being carried through mortality's dangerous open ground into gathering and mercy, while the same boundary remains destructive when no protective admission follows.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates prepared guest-provision from a descent root used for revelation, not a direct hospitality expression in the focus. It remains anchored by causative entry, the Lord as host-owner, care as destination, and the later contrastive shelter. Downstream prose should call it a hospitality echo generated by the context, not a lexical translation of either revelation or mercy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The Lord causes entry into His own domain of care, a construction compatible with reception by a host, while an early branch supplies provision prepared for an arriving guest.

activation_trace.role: Entry supplies the guest-like arrival into an interior.
Ownership of the domain permits a cautious host-and-reception relation.
Beneficent care specifies the quality of the reception.
Provision prepared for an arriving guest activates the hospitality frame from the opening revelation movement.
Joining a shelter provides the negative lodging contrast that keeps the focus reception spatially anchored.

changed_reading.before: Admission into mercy is an abstract allocation of favor.
changed_reading.after: Admission can carry a contained hospitality echo: the sovereign Lord receives the arriving group into His care as a prepared, sustaining welcome rather than leaving them to the destructive shelter.

strongest_changes: Mercy shifted from a static reward to a life-producing environment patterned by rain, revived earth, and transformed conditions.
Righteous action acquired the concrete social form of forgiveness, making divine mercy answer a mercy-like practice without becoming payment for it.
Manifest success became a disclosed, discriminating verdict grounded in a speaking record rather than mere obvious happiness.
The denied exit from fire exposed mercy as the opposing protective enclosure into which the Lord actively places people.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact spatial grammar held together several live mechanisms without requiring a single resolution: cultivation, ecological renewal, navigation, relational repair, guidance, adjudicative enrollment, and opposed enclosures. The split mapping attached to the focus Lord and the shadow branches under success preserved especially productive surprises.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether mercy in the focus primarily names a final destination or also the present revealed way remains open.
The social connection carried by the final disclosure root is branch-distant and should remain secondary to direct clarity.
The gestational, mortality-passage, and hospitality readings are coherent echoes but should not be promoted to lexical glosses.
The record may explain evidential disclosure without implying formal enrollment, so the juridical mechanism remains an inference rather than an explicit procedural sequence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Mercy is an inhabitable interior.** `د خ ل/B001` is entering an inside, `ر ح م/B003` is womb, and `ر ح م/B001` mercy and tenderness. The grammar does not merely assign mercy; it causes entry into it. The packet began with the doubled mercy names (45:0) and moved through creation, life, and gathering. I infer that the final beneficial outcome completes a gestational arc: trust and sound action are brought inside a sustaining enclosure. Victory is therefore secure placement, not only escape.
2. **Separation becomes clarification.** `ف و ز/B001` combines winning good with escape, while `ب ي ن/B001` is separation after connection. The paired outcomes in 45:30-31 supply the separation. I infer that `المبين` describes a victory made manifest by decisive differentiation from the contrary path. Its clarity is relational: the outcome becomes visible because judgment no longer allows unlike histories to remain mixed.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 45:31's contrasting address makes the separating force of `المبين` explicit; later praise in 45:36 shows the beneficial enclosure terminating in recognition rather than self-congratulation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Entry into mercy is entry into a protective, generative interior.** Lexical anchors: entering in `د خ ل B001`, hidden interior in `د خ ل B003`, nurture/completion in `ر ب ب B002`, and the womb image in `ر ح م B003` alongside beneficent mercy in `ر ح م B001`. The packet supplies life, death, and regathering in 45:26, then no exit from the opposite destination in 45:35. I infer sound work -> nurtured admission -> enclosing life-bearing care. Mercy becomes a habitable interior, not an abstract quantity bestowed from outside.
2. **Manifest victory is successful passage between escape and peril.** Lexical anchors: winning good/escape in `ف و ز B001`, the desert passage between escape and peril in `ف و ز B003`, and becoming clear in `ب ي ن B004`. The packet supplies the assembled judgment scene in 45:28-29 and the opposed trajectory in 45:31-35. I infer record-tested route -> safe passage -> visible outcome. `ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْمُبِينُ` reads as arrival through a dangerous crossing whose alternative is locally displayed, not as a static prize.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 45:35's negated exit made the interior scope of `د خ ل B003` and the passage scope of `ف و ز B003` visible by contrast. Mercy is the enclosing destination reached safely; the opposed destination encloses without either escape or restorative return.

baseline.text: İnanıp iyi işler yapanlara gelince, Rableri onları rahmetinin içine alacaktır. İşte apaçık başarı budur.

findings.text: Rahmet, dışarıdan verilen soyut bir pay değil, Rabbin insanı yetiştirip içine aldığı koruyucu ve hayat taşıyan bir iç mekândır.
Apaçık başarı, kayıtla sınanan tehlikeli bir geçişten güvenle çıkıp karşıt sonuçtan kesin biçimde ayrılan görünür varıştır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Action is materially joined into a record, copied into durable form, summoned before a collective, and made to speak as evidence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The book is simultaneously an assembled object, a registry, a copied image, an articulate witness, and an instrument of settlement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Document Speaks as Proof
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The completed record acquires a voice, discloses its meaning, and establishes truth before those made to see it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: intelligible speech (`quranic:root_001519:B001/m01`); evidence that speaks for itself (`quranic:root_001519:B002/m01`); disclosure by statement or sign (`quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`); truth matching reality (`quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`); establishing and manifesting truth (`quranic:root_000347:B005/m01`); sight of the presented scene (`quranic:root_000531:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The record crosses media without losing identity: writing becomes articulate evidence. Its voice does not add a new claim but discloses and fixes the correspondence between recorded action and reality.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Judgment assigns bodies and collectives a posture, then places them within opposed enclosures from which the final condition is experienced.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Mercy takes on the enclosing and generative form of a womb, while fire is named as a shelter whose defining feature is compulsory residence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Mercy Encloses Like a Womb
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The faithful are brought across an ingress into a nurturing enclosure whose outcome is rescue and secured good.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: entry into an interior (`quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`); merciful care (`quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`); womb as enclosing place of growth (`quranic:root_000552:B003/m01`); nurture toward completion (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`); rescue and attainment of good (`quranic:root_001186:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Entry into mercy activates more than an abstract favorable state. The رحم image supplies an interior that protects and develops, lordly nurture governs the process, and `فوز` names emergence as rescue and attainment.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal inanma ya da dua cevabi degil; korkudan emin olma, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin guven ve korkusuzluk anlamlari ile belirli yapimli ya da soz obegi kullanislari birlikte vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir dar kaliba indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bu dali korkunun ziddi olan guven, kalbin yatismasi ve guven verme alaninda toplar. Ayni iddia guvenilir kisi, emanet, guvenli yer ve dayanilir binek gibi turemis ya da baglamli kullanislari da cekirdege baglar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali acikca tasdik, haber ya da vaadi dogru sayma ve bazi dini kullanislarda hakka boyun egme olarak verir. Provisional cerceve guvene dokunan yanini not eder, fakat dal kimligi korkusuzluk degil tasdik ve kabul iliskisidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalin ortak cekirdegini tasdik olarak verir ve bir sozun dogru sayilmasini temsil eden ornegi buna baglar. Ayni iddia, daha ozel dini kullanimlarda hakka icten boyun egme, yola girme ve vaatle ilgili dogrulama boyutlarinin eklendigini de gosterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali dua icinde soylenen bir kabul istegi sozu ve bu sozu soyleme eylemi olarak verir. Cerceve, guven ve tasdik dallarindan ayrildigi ve sadece dua cevabi formuluyle ilgili oldugu icin uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik ya da tasdik degil; duada kabul talebini bildiren sabit sozdur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal belirli bir dua sozu ve onu soyleme eylemiyle sinirlidir; buradan genel guven ya da tasdik anlami cikarilmaz.

concept_map.definition: Dua sonunda kabul edilme istegini bildiren ve 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' ya da 'bunu yap' anlaminda aciklanan sabit sozdur. Dal ayrica bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve kaynaklarda aktarılan ad yorumunu da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek, duada kabul istegini bildiren sabit cevap sozudur.
Kaynaklar sozun anlamini 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' veya 'bunu yap' seklinde aciklar.
Bu sozu soyleme eylemi de ayni dal icinde adlandirilir.
Bazi aktarimlarda bu sozun ilahi bir ad oldugu yorumu da dalin yan rivayeti olarak bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak dali dua icinde soylenen ve kabul istegi tasiyan sabit bir soz olarak anlatir. Ayni iddia, bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve sozun anlamina dair 'kabul et' ya da 'oyle olsun' aciklamalarini da icerir; ad yorumu ise bu ortak malzemenin yan aktarimidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dua sonunda soylenen sabit kabul talebi ve onu soyleme eylemi icin genel karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Dua baglamini, kabul istegini ve sabit soz niteligini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sozun dua icindeki anlamini eylemli bicimde cevirmek gerektiginde uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Sabit soz ve onu soyleme eylemi olma tarafini eksiltir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Duanin sonucuna katilma ve gerceklesmesini dileme baglaminda dogal karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Kabul ve gerceklesme istegini korur.
error_profile.loses: Ilahi muhataba yonelen talep kuvvetini ve sozu soyleme eylemini tam tasimaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylem adi olan kullanimda, yani bu sozu telaffuz etme anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sozu soyleme eylemini ve dua baglamini korur.
error_profile.loses: Sozun tek basina anlamini ve ad yorumu yanini kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu kolu, canlı bir yapanın bilerek ortaya koyduğu iş veya eylem olarak kurar. İyi ve kötü davranış örnekleri bu çekirdeğin ahlaki alanlara da uygulanabildiğini gösterir; ücret, görev, karşılıklı işlem veya özel adlar bu kola ait değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kapsam, bilinçli yapılan iş ve eylemle sınırlıdır; ücret, resmi görev, karşılıklı alışveriş ve nesne ya da beden parçası adları ayrı kollardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem yalın iş anlamı hem de belirli kalıplı kullanımlar vardır; tanım yalın çekirdeği verir, kalıplı örnekleri bu çekirdeğe bağlı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Canlı bir yapanın bilerek gerçekleştirdiği iş veya eylemdir; iyi ya da kötü davranışları da kapsayabilir. Kendisi için çalışmak ya da işe yoğun biçimde girişmek bu çekirdeğin özel kullanımıdır.

facets.statement: Bir yapanın bilerek ortaya koyduğu iş veya eylem anlamı çekirdektir.
İyi ve kötü davranışlar da bilinçli eylem alanı içinde yer alır.
Kişinin kendisi için çalışması veya işe dalması bu çekirdeğin özel bir görünümüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, anlamı canlı bir yapanın bilinçli biçimde yaptığı iş veya eylem olarak toplar; bu kapsam iyi ve kötü davranış örneklerine de uygulanır.

facets.statement: İş karşılığı verilen ücret veya çalışanın payı ana anlamdır.
Çalışanın geçimliği veya kazancı olarak da anlaşılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, anlamı yapılan işin karşılığı olan ücret, pay veya çalışana ayrılan geçimlik olarak birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Çalışana yaptığı işin karşılığı olarak verilen ücret veya pay anlatıldığında doğrudan uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İş karşılığı verilen maddi karşılığı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ücretin yapılan işe bağlı olduğunu vurgulamak gereken yerlerde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İş ve karşılık ilişkisini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Özellikle iş yapan kişinin iş karşılığı aldığı paydır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Karşılık, ödül, kira, yarar ve sözleşme ücreti gibi daha geniş alanları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yapılan bir iş için verilen karşılık alanında örtüşürler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu kol genel karşılık ve ödül alanına yayılır; bu kol iş yapanın iş karşılığı aldığı ücrette kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Çalışanın yaptığı işin olağan karşılığıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir iş için önceden belirlenmiş ödül veya vaat edilen karşılık yönü öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de bir işin karşılığında verilen şeydir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol çalışan payı veya ücretidir; komşu kol belirli bir işi yaptırmak için konmuş ödül ya da anlaşılmış karşılık anlamına kayar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İş karşılığında verilen ücrettir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Elle çalışan işçi topluluğudur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İş ve çalışma alanını paylaşırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol maddi karşılığı adlandırır; komşu kol işi yapan insan topluluğunu adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adaylar karşılık, geçim, kazanç ve işçi alanlarındadır; ücretin eylemden ve işçi topluluğundan ayrılması ana sınırdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişiyle alışverişte ve benzeri işlerde karşılıklı işlem yürütmeyi anlatır. Bu nedenle kol, tek başına iş yapma ya da iş ücreti değil, kişiler arası işlem ilişkisidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kapsam kişiler arasındaki karşılıklı işlemle sınırlıdır; genel iş, ücret ve resmi görev anlamları dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Form ve kalıp birlikte verilir; tanım karşılıklı işlem yapısına bağlı kalır ve yalın iş anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: İki kişi arasında alışverişte veya benzeri işlerde karşılıklı işlem yürütmektir. Tek taraflı iş yapma ya da iş karşılığı ücret alma anlamı taşımaz.

facets.statement: Bir kişiyle karşılıklı işlem yürütme ana anlamdır.
Alışveriş bu karşılıklı işlem alanının belirgin örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, anlamı bir kişiyle alışverişte veya başka işlerde karşılıklı işlem yürütme olarak verir; ilişki iki taraflıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: İki taraf arasında alışveriş veya benzeri iş ilişkisi yürütüldüğünde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İki taraflı işlem ve alışverişe uygulanma çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Karşılıklı işlemin satış ve satın alma bağlamında geçtiği yerlerde doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: İki taraflı alışveriş ilişkisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Alışveriş dışındaki karşılıklı işlem alanlarını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir kimseyle alışveriş veya benzeri işlem yaptı

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Alışveriş dışındaki karşılıklı işlemleri de kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Satış ve satın alma eylemleri ile bedel ilişkisi daha belirgindir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki taraf arasında mal veya bedel üzerinden işlem yapma alanında örtüşürler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu kol alım satımın kendi yönlerine odaklanır; bu kol kişiyle işlem yürütme ilişkisini daha genel tutar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir kişiyle işlem görme ilişkisi alışverişten daha geniştir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Satın alma ve satma karşılıklılığı daha doğrudan adlandırılır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Alışverişte iki taraflı değiş tokuş alanını paylaşırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol işlem ilişkisinin kişisel yönünü taşır; komşu kol alım ve satımın bedelli değişimini öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İki taraf arasında işlem yürütür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir yapanın bilinçli işini veya davranışını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İş ve eylem alanı ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol karşılıklı ilişki şartı taşır; komşu kol tek yapanın eylemini de kapsayan genel iş alanıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adaylar alışveriş, bedel, iki taraflılık ve borç ilişkisi çevresindedir; sınır en çok alım satım kollarıyla belirginleşir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu kolu, elleriyle kazı, kuyu kaplama, çamur işi ve benzeri işleri yapan topluluk olarak verir. Bu, aynı yazılışla görülen ücret anlamından ve genel iş eyleminden ayrıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kapsam elle çalışan işçi topluluğudur; iş karşılığı ücret ve yaya yolcular anlamları ayrı kollardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik profil yalın ad anlamı verir; tanım işçi topluluğunu açıklar ve ücret ya da yolculuk anlamı eklemez.

concept_map.definition: El emeğiyle kazı, kuyu kaplama, çamur işi ve benzeri işleri yapan işçi topluluğudur. Anlam, ücret veya yalnızca yapılan iş değil, işi yapan insan grubudur.

facets.statement: Ellerini kullanarak çeşitli ağır işleri yapan insan topluluğu ana anlamdır.
Kazı, kuyu kaplama ve çamur işi verilen örnek iş türleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, anlamı elleriyle çeşitli işler yapan topluluk olarak verir; kazı, kuyu kaplama ve çamur işi bu iş türlerine örnektir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ellerini kullanarak kazı, çamur işi veya benzeri işleri yapan insan topluluğu anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Elle çalışan insan topluluğu ve iş türleri çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: El emeğiyle ağır iş yapan grup için konuşma diline yakın bir karşılık gerektiğinde kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Elle çalışan işçi topluluğu yanını korur.
error_profile.adds: Güncel Türkçede toplumsal ton ve kaba işçilik çağrışımı ekleyebilir.
error_profile.collision: Kaynak köke bağlı ödünç biçim olduğu için açıklayıcı ana karşılık yerine kullanılmamalıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Elle çalışan topluluk anlamına bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İşçi topluluğunun yanında belirli zanaat sahibi kişiye de açılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de çamur, kazı ve benzeri el işleri yapanları anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu kol işçi veya zanaat yapan kişi alanını daha geniş tutar; bu kol özellikle elle çalışan topluluk olarak sınırlandırılır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Elle çalışan işçi topluluğunu adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: El işi becerisi, zanaat ve ustalık niteliğini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: El işi ve zanaat ortamını paylaşırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol insan grubudur; komşu kol beceri, meslek ve ustalık niteliğidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İşi yapan insan topluluğudur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İşin karşılığı olan ücrettir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İş ve çalışma alanını paylaşırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol çalışanları gösterir; komşu kol çalışanlara verilen karşılığı gösterir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adaylar işçi, zanaat, araç, kazı ve ücret alanlarında toplanır; topluluk ile ücret ve beceri ayrımı en yararlı sınırdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu kolu belirli kalıplarda zahmete girme veya kendini yorma anlamıyla verir. Genel çalışma ve kendisi için çalışma anlamları özellikle dışarıda bırakılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kapsam kalıplı söyleyişlerde zahmet çekmedir; yalın iş yapmak veya kendisi için çalışmak anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik profil kalıplı kullanım verir; tanım yalnız bu yapılardaki zahmete girme anlamını kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Belirli anlatımlarda bir iş veya ihtiyaç için zahmete girme, kendini yorma anlamıdır. Bu kol genel çalışma ya da kendisi için iş yapma anlamına taşınmaz.

facets.statement: Bir iş uğruna zahmete girme ve kendini yorma ana anlamdır.
Yasaklama kalıbı, kişinin kendini yormamasını isteme olarak kullanılır.
Birinin ihtiyacı için zahmete girmeyi bildiren yardım bağlamı da verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, anlamı yalnız kalıplı söyleyişlerde zahmete girme veya kendini yorma olarak sınırlar; genel iş yapma anlamı burada taşınmaz.

source_details.summary: Tek kaynaklı tanıklık, hem yasaklama hem yardım bağlamında zahmete girme anlamını verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir iş veya başkasının ihtiyacı için kendini yorma anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Zahmet çekme, kendini yorma ve bir ihtiyaç için uğraşma çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yasaklama veya uyarı bağlamında kişinin zahmet çekmemesi istendiğinde doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Kendini yorma ve zahmet çekme yanını korur.
error_profile.loses: Başkasının ihtiyacı için olumlu biçimde zahmete girme yanını daraltır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Zahmete girme anlamı belirli iş kalıplarına bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sıkıntı, zorluk ve genel yorulma alanı daha geniştir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de yorgunluk ve sıkıntı veren uğraşı anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol bir iş için bilerek zahmete girmeyi anlatır; komşu kol genel zorluk ve sıkıntı durumunu anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kalıplı söyleyişte kendini yorma veya zahmet etme anlamıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Gücü sonuna kadar harcama, yemin veya zorlu geçim gibi daha geniş alanları vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Çaba ve güç harcama alanı ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu kol kapasite ve sınırına kadar zorlanma anlamını taşır; bu kol belirli söz kalıplarında zahmet çekmeye bağlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Zahmet çekme anlamı yalnız kalıplı kullanımdadır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Genel bilinçli iş veya eylem anlamıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İş ve uğraş alanını paylaşırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol zahmet ve yorgunluk tarafını taşır; komşu kol her bilinçli işi kapsayan daha temel eylem alanıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adaylar zorluk, güç harcama, ağır yük ve iş alanındadır; kalıplı zahmet anlamı genel çalışma anlamından ayrılmalıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insan ve deve için işe yatkın, çalışmaya yaratılıştan elverişli olma niteliğini; deve adlarında ise üstün ve işe dayanıklı oluşu gösterir. Bu, sadece işi yapan kişi veya işçi topluluğu anlamı değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kapsam işe yatkınlık ve iş için yaratılıştan elverişliliktir; genel yapan kişi veya işçi topluluğu anlamı eklenmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Formlar ve kalıplar birlikte verilir; tanım insan niteliği ile deve adı arasındaki işe yatkınlık bağını korur.

concept_map.definition: İşe yatkın veya çalışmaya yaratılıştan elverişli olma niteliğidir. İnsan için çalışkan yaradılış, deve için üstün ve işe dayanıklı dişi deve adı olarak görülür.

facets.statement: İşe yatkın ve çalışmaya elverişli olma niteliği ana anlamdır.
İnsan için çalışmaya yaratılıştan yatkın kişi niteliği verilir.
Deve için üstün, güçlü ve işe dayanıklı dişi deve adı olarak kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, insan ve deve örneklerini işe yatkınlık çevresinde birleştirir; deve adları üstünlük ve işe dayanıklılık niteliğini taşır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Çalışmaya yaratılıştan elverişli kişi veya işe dayanıklı üstün dişi deve anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İşe yatkınlık, dayanıklılık ve insan ile deve kullanımını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin çalışmaya doğal olarak yatkın oluşu anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İnsan için işe yatkınlık niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Deve adı ve hayvana ilişkin üstünlük tarafını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deve adı veya nitelikli dişi deve bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Deveye ilişkin işe dayanıklılık ve üstünlük yanını korur.
error_profile.loses: İnsan için çalışkan yaradılış anlamını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: işe yatkın, güçlü ve üstün dişi deve

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İşe ve çalışmaya yatkınlık alanına bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Genel elverişlilik, hazırlanmışlık ve iyiye yatkınlık daha geniştir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir şey için uygun ve yatkın olma alanında örtüşürler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu kol genel uygunluk ve hazırlığa açılır; bu kol iş görmeye yatkınlık ve dayanıklılık sınırındadır.
